name: Indonesia
summary: Equatorial Southeast Asian archipelago with dense tropical peatland ecosystems. Experiences seasonal biomass smoke spikes alongside expanding industrial coal generation and critical nickel processing corridors.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 5.70x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); severe regional haze during dry season peat fire years.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; marine heatwaves impact coral reefs across the Coral Triangle.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Equatorial warming trend rate over 1994-2023 trailing three decades.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 1.9% share of global fossil emissions; coal-fired power buildout doubled over the past decade.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Moderate per capita emissions; excludes major peatland oxidation and land clearing emissions.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Contains ~890,000 km² of megadiverse tropical rainforests across Sumatra, Borneo, and Papua.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Generation from hydropower (10.6%) and world-leading geothermal capacity (5.4%).

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 153 people/km²; Java hosts over 55% of the total population.
